title: Banking Regulator Chief Kavcıoğlu Resigns as Fund Scandal Widens
detail: Banking regulator (BDDK) chief Şahap Kavcıoğlu submitted his resignation, following the SPK chief's exit on Oct 19. Over 120 people, including at least eight current and former regulator officials, have been detained in the investment-fund probe, which Al-Monitor puts at more than $20 billion.
